answer_1.quote: Empirical results on six tasks—including multiturn conversation, code generation, and mathematical reasoning—across three LLM families (Llama 2, Llama 3) with model sizes ranging from 7B to 70B demonstrate that SPECTRA outperforms other non-training speculative decoding methods.

answer_2.quote: We only evaluate the acceleration performance using the following metrics. • Speedup Ratio: The speedup ratio relative to autoregressive decoding. • Compression ratio τ : The ratio of the total number of autoregressive steps to the number of Spectra decoding steps needed to produce the same sequence length. Additionally, ROUGE-1, ROUGE-2, and ROUGE-L scores are reported for summarization tasks.
